title: DCSS 2nd Grade ELA Pacing Calendar
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Nov 9–13, Wednesday 11 (Session 3), Vocabulary row] dunes, canyon, cactus, spines, shelter
[Nov 30–Dec 4, I Can] I can read and write words with long u (u_e, ue, ew, u). / I can read and write words with the prefixes re- and pre-. / I can read high-frequency words: because, word, work, write.
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Monday 30 (Session 11), Phonics row] Introduce Long u (u_e, ue)
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Wednesday 2 (Session 13), Phonics row] Introduce Long u (ew, u)
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Monday 30 (Session 11), High-Frequency Words row] because, word, work, write
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Monday 30 (Session 11), Vocabulary row] adapted, predators, scales
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Wednesday 2 (Session 13), Vocabulary row] nonliving, nectar, protect, adapted
[Dec 7–11, I Can] I can read and write words with silent letters (wr, kn, gn, mb, sc). / I can decode words with the prefixes un- and dis-. / I can read high-frequency words: after, one, warm, your. / I can identify the author's main purpose of a text.
[Dec 7–11, Monday 7 (Session 16), Phonics row] Introduce Silent Letters (wr, kn)
[Dec 7–11, Wednesday 9 (Session 18), Phonics row] Introduce Silent Letters (gn, mb, sc)
[Dec 7–11, Monday 7 (Session 16), High-Frequency Words row] after, one, warm, your
[Dec 7–11, Wednesday 9 (Session 18), Vocabulary row] den, store, horizon
